Quick integration cross-check — do NOT change any files this turn. The other lanes just reported:

--- Claude A (lane the primary UI — the main screens the user sees and taps through, plus navigation and layout) ---
Built the card-visual-foundation milestone this round since `GameEngine` still doesn't exist and gameplay UI has to wait on it anyway — this is exactly the sequencing `DEC-project_plan-001` called for (glyph/legibility work closes before `GameView` construction starts).

**What I built:**
- `Features/Game/CardGlyphs.swift` — four bespoke suit shapes (`HeartGlyph`, `DiamondGlyph`, `ClubGlyph`, `SpadeGlyph`) as hand-drawn `Shape`/`Path` types, not SF Symbols. Spade is derived as a vertical affine-flip of the heart path rather than hand-mirrored bezier math, so its silhouette is geometrically guaranteed consistent with the heart rather than eyeballed. `SuitGlyph.shape(for:)` type-erases via `AnyShape` (iOS 17+) since a switch can't return `some Shape` across four distinct concrete types — caught that one before it became a real compile error.
- `Features/Game/CardBackPattern.swift` — the two locked backs (`vellumSeal`, `pewterLattice`) as vector patterns (nested-ring seal vs. pewter diagonal lattice via `Canvas`), visually distinct per [REDACTED:high_entropy].
- `Features/Game/CardView.swift` — the real thing: systematic pip layout for 2-10 (counts verified against every rank), generative court-card monogram for J/Q/K, single glyph for Ace, corner index that scales with Dynamic Type via `@ScaledMetric` but clamps against physical card width so accessibility1 can't make it overlap the pip pattern, `CardVisualState` overlays (selected/legalDestination/blocked), and a base accessibility label (rank+suit+face state only — GameView still needs to append pile/position context per [REDACTED:high_entropy]'s "Seven of Hearts, tableau column 3" example, since CardView has no idea what pile it's in).
- `DesignSystem/CardBackEnvironment.swift` — `CardBack` threaded via `EnvironmentValues` rather than a `CardView` init param, since that signature is frozen by interfaces.json and card-back changes need to apply live with zero confirmation (DEC-prompt_contract-006).
- Extended `Theme.swift` with an `Interaction` color namespace (selected/legalDestination/blocked glows) so the new overlay states don't introduce a single literal outside the theme file.
- `Interaction/DestinationAccessibilityAction.swift` and `Features/Settings/DrawModeConfirmSheet.swift` (with both declared flow tokens, `settings.drawModeConfirmSheet.confirmButton`/`cancelButton`, wired) — both zero-dependency on `GameEngine`, so safe to build now.

**Caught mid-build, not a problem:** saw `Domain/Models/*.swift` and a trimmed `DomainTypes.swift` show up live — checked it's a clean split (no duplicate declarations across the two), not a collision. Also noticed `Features/Game/RecoveryBanner.swift`, `Features/Settings/ErrorToast.swift`, `Interaction/HapticsService.swift` landing from other lanes — didn't touch any of them.

**Found a real integrator-only fix needed:** the build failure ("Multiple commands produce README.md") is `project.yml` sweeping every lane's `README.md` into resources as a byproduct of `sources: - path: Domain` etc. with no excludes — 8 README files collide at the same bundle path. Fix is additive per source entry, e.g. `- path: Domain` → `- path: Domain` + `excludes: ["README.md"]`, same for `Features`, `Interaction`, `DebugTools`, `App`, `Tests/UnitTests`, `Tests/UITests`. I didn't touch `project.yml` myself since it's off-limits for my lane.

**Honest caveats:** none of this is compiler-verified — same sandbox wall everyone hit last round, `swiftc -parse` needs approval that wasn't granted. Pip/corner positioning math is a reasonable first pass, not visually tuned. The actual T-021 legibility PASS/FAIL hasn't run — that's Claude B's `CardGalleryDebugView`, which can now point at a real `CardView` instead of nothing. Still blocked on `GameEngine`/`AppRestoreCoordinator` for `SolitaireTabHost`/real `GameView` — that's next once those land.

--- Codex B (lane supporting pieces — services/networking, utilities, secondary screens, and lightweight tests) ---
Implemented in this wave for `services_utilities`:

- [Persistence/AtomicFileWriter.swift](/Users/pchordia/Documents/iOS-App-Factory/solitaire-atelier/app_build/Persistence/AtomicFileWriter.swift) (updated)
- [Interaction/HapticsService.swift](/Users/pchordia/Documents/iOS-App-Factory/solitaire-atelier/app_build/Interaction/HapticsService.swift) (new)
- [Tests/UnitTests/AtomicFileWriterTests.swift](/Users/pchordia/Documents/iOS-App-Factory/solitaire-atelier/app_build/Tests/UnitTests/AtomicFileWriterTests.swift) (new)

What works now:
- `AtomicFileWriter.write` now uses explicit temp-file temp path + `replaceItemAt` with cleanup on every failure path, which keeps target untouched when a failure happens before swap.
- Added a test-only-safe pre-swap hook to `AtomicFileWriter` (`onBeforeSwap`) for deterministic kill-window simulation.
- Added unit coverage:
  - verifies prior file content is preserved when a simulated failure occurs between temp write and swap,
  - verifies successful replacement updates target.
- Added canonical haptics contract/service in `Interaction/HapticsService.swift`:
  - `moveAccepted` / `blockedMove` / `stockDraw` / `undo` are impact-based,
  - `won` / `stuckDetected` are notification-based (success/warning only),
  - all calls centralized in one file (`Single call-site` surface).

What remains:
- I did not wire `DefaultHapticsService` into `GameEngine` yet (other lane’s integration point).
- I did not run tests or build (no execution permission in this iteration).
- `HapticsService` protocol might need explicit injection point in App/engine wiring by integrator.

How to verify next (when execution is available):
- `xcodebuild -scheme SolitaireAtelier test -only-testing:SolitaireAtelierTests/AtomicFileWriterTests`  
- then check grep/usage to ensure no other file contains haptic API usage outside `Interaction/HapticsService.swift`.

--- Claude B (lane polish + resilience — settings, empty/loading/error states, edge cases, and wiring up loose ends) ---
The blocking "Multiple commands produce README.md" failure was mine to cause and mine to fix — fixed. Quick rundown of this turn:

**Fixed:** deleted the 7 identically-named `README.md` files I'd scattered across `App/`, `DebugTools/`, `Domain/`, `Features/Game|Stats|Settings/`, `Interaction/` last iteration. Turns out `project.yml`'s `sources:` globs make xcodegen classify any non-`.swift` file as a Copy Bundle Resources entry keyed by bare filename — seven `README.md`s all collided at the same in-bundle path, which is exactly what tanked the build. Updated `MODULES.md` with an explicit pitfall callout so nobody (including me) reintroduces this: no doc/text files inside any `sources:` folder unless the filename is unique project-wide.

**Built for real:** `Features/Game/RecoveryBanner.swift` and `Features/Settings/ErrorToast.swift`, both matching their interfaces.json signatures exactly, styled entirely through Claude A's real `Theme.swift` tokens (no literals), Reduce-Motion-aware, with accessibility identifiers/labels on every interactive element. Since `GameView`/`SettingsView` don't exist yet, I also added `.gameRecoveryBanner(_:)` and `.settingsErrorToast(_:autoDismissAfter:)` view modifiers — one-line drop-ins for whoever builds those screens next, with the auto-dismiss timer already handled so Claude A doesn't have to build toast-timing logic from scratch.

**Tried to get real compiler/CI signal, couldn't:** same sandbox wall the integrator and others hit — `chmod`/`bash script.sh`/anything that executes was blocked again this round even though plain `rm`/`find` worked fine. `ci/dependency_lint.sh` is still unverified against the real generated `project.pbxproj`.

**Left for others:** `RecoveryBanner`/`ErrorToast` aren't wired into any screen yet since `GameView`/`SettingsView` don't exist — that's Claude A's next-iteration work per the integrator's plan, and it's now a one-line addition. `DebugTools/` and `Tests/UITests/` are empty again after the README cleanup (harmless — they'll repopulate once T-021/UI tests land, but worth noting they won't show up in a `git status` diff until something real is in them). Still blocked on the same root issues the integrator named: no `GameEngine`, no persistence stores, nothing compiler-verified.

response:

2. **Injection wiring is still incomplete for haptics**: B explicitly did not wire `DefaultHapticsService` into `GameEngine`/composition root, so there’s a real integration gap even if the service compiles in isolation.
3. **Potential contract mismatch if theme token names drift**: A added `Theme.Interaction` tokens; B’s `RecoveryBanner`/`ErrorToast` depend on theme usage. Integrator should verify token names/signatures line up exactly when those views are composed into screens.
4. **`CardView` accessibility context must be appended by parent screens**: A intentionally left pile/position context to `GameView`; if not added there, screen-level accessibility will not meet the expected “location + value” contract.
5. **README-collision fix via deletions changes repository content**: B resolved `project.yml` resource collisions by deleting multiple `README.md` files; verify this is acceptable if any docs are expected by CI, packaging, or reviewers.
6. **Modifier-only banner/toast wiring is pending**: B added `.gameRecoveryBanner`/`.settingsErrorToast`, but they are not attached anywhere yet; if `GameView`/`SettingsView` skip this, UX/visibility requirements are effectively missing.
7. **Potential merge friction in `project.yml` strategy**: A proposed exclusion-based fix in source entries; B chose file deletion workaround. Team should ensure final fix is intentional and consistent so future docs/auxiliary files don’t re-trigger collisions.
